assumptions: BLAST+ blastn/blastp scoring, with E-values from this project's database size.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which of this project's own records carry this span, with what E-values?

description: Search a sequence against THIS PROJECT'S OWN records with blastn or blastp, on this machine: the local database is built from every project record of the program's alphabet, and every E-value is computed from that database's own size. Use it to ask which of my constructs, reads or proteins carry this span. Nothing leaves the machine; for public databases use blast_search.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

feature.description: the feature's name, matched case-insensitively on the open record. Only applies when region is feature.

maxExpect.description: E-value cutoff (BLAST+'s -evalue); hits above it are not reported.

program.description: blastn searches the nucleotide records, blastp the protein records. Values: blastn (blastn · nucleotide query), blastp (blastp · protein query).

region.description: which part of the open record to search, when no sequence is wired in. Values: whole (the whole record), selection (the current selection), feature (a named feature).

sequence.description: the query. Wire a record or a sequence output, or paste raw/FASTA. Left empty, the region below is taken from the open record.

name: blast_project_sequences

hits.description: every hit, with its HSPs, accession, organism and the links the service sent

provenance.description: the binary, the command line EBI ran, the databases as built, and the search space the E-values are relative to

sequences.description: the hit subjects as FASTA, ready to wire straight into an alignment or a tree

tabular.description: the hits as BLAST's own outfmt 6 table, for download or a downstream parser

topCoverage.description: what fraction of the query the best hit covers, 0–1

topExpect.description: the best hit's E-value; wire into a $when to branch on significance

topHit.description: the best hit by E-value: what a "what is this?" step reads

topIdentity.description: percent identity of the best hit's best HSP
